app.name: Breathe
interval.label: Reminder interval
main.running.support: A short break now helps you focus better later.
main.off.label: Reminders are off
main.off.support: Turn on eye rest or movement reminders in Settings.
main.paused.label: Paused
main.paused.support: Reminders are paused. You can resume them anytime.
main.snoozed.label: Snoozed
main.snoozed.supportSoon: The next reminder is scheduled shortly.
main.awaiting.eyes.label: Time to rest your eyes
main.awaiting.eyes.support: Look into the distance. Take a short break, or snooze for a while.
main.awaiting.movement.label: Time to move a little
main.awaiting.movement.support: Stand up and stretch. Take a short break, or snooze for a while.
main.break.eyes.label: Eye break
main.break.eyes.support: Let your eyes rest on something far away. The next countdown starts after your break.
main.break.movement.label: Movement break
main.break.movement.support: Stretch or walk around. The next countdown starts after your break.
reminder.eyes.title: Time to rest your eyes
reminder.eyes.body: Look away from the screen and let your eyes rest on something far away.
reminder.movement.title: Time to move a little
reminder.movement.body: Stand up, stretch, and give your body a chance to move.
reminder.breakOver.title: Break's over
reminder.breakOver.body: Welcome back. Your next reminder countdown has started.
phrase.eyesRight: Your eyes have a right over you.
phrase.bodyRight: Your body has a right over you.
phrase.timeAndTime: A time for effort, and a time for rest.
phrase.pastTime: Dwelling on time already lost only loses more of it.
phrase.notAnHour: Not an hour of my life is mine to waste.
settings.general.title: General
settings.general.description: Configure how Breathe works for you.
settings.general.interval.description: How often you would like to take a break.
settings.general.scheduling.title: Reminder scheduling
settings.general.scheduling.active: Scheduling is active. Breaks are being counted down.
settings.general.scheduling.paused: Scheduling is paused. No reminders will be delivered.
settings.general.bothOff: Both reminder types are turned off, so Breathe will stay quiet. Enable eye rest or movement reminders under Reminders.
settings.general.intervalNote: Changing the interval restarts the current countdown: the next reminder is scheduled one full interval from the moment you change it.
settings.general.language.title: Language
settings.general.language.description: The language Breathe uses, independent of your system language.
settings.reminders.title: Reminders
settings.reminders.description: Choose what Breathe nudges you about, and how.
settings.reminders.eyes.title: Eye break reminders
settings.reminders.eyes.description: Remind me to look away from the screen for a moment.
settings.reminders.movement.title: Movement reminders
settings.reminders.movement.description: Remind me to stand up, stretch and move.
settings.reminders.snooze.title: Allow snoozing
settings.reminders.snooze.description: Lets you postpone a reminder by {count} minutes from the popup, the main window and the tray.
settings.reminders.style.title: Reminder style
settings.reminders.style.popupDescriptio: A small Breathe window with Take a break and Snooze buttons.
settings.reminders.style.systemDescripti: Your system's notifications. Take a break or snooze from the tray or the Breathe window.
settings.reminders.sound.title: Play a sound
settings.reminders.sound.description: A soft chime when a reminder appears and when a break ends.
settings.reminders.alternating: Both types are enabled, so Breathe alternates between them. {kind} is next.
settings.reminders.onlyEyes: Eye break reminders are enabled, so every reminder is an eye rest.
settings.reminders.onlyMovement: Movement reminders are enabled, so every reminder is a movement break.
settings.reminders.testNote: The test shows the popup for the next reminder category, through the same path as real reminders. Snoozing schedules a single reminder {count} minutes from now.
settings.reminders.testFailed: Could not show the test reminder. {error}
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.appearance.description: Breathe follows your desktop by default.
settings.appearance.system.label: Follow system
settings.appearance.system.description: Matches your desktop's light or dark preference.
settings.appearance.light.label: Light
settings.appearance.dark.label: Dark
settings.appearance.note: The theme is applied to every Breathe window immediately and is restored the next time the app starts.
settings.startup.title: Startup
settings.startup.description: Run Breathe quietly when you log in.
settings.startup.toggle.title: Start with user session
settings.startup.toggle.description: Launches Breathe hidden in the background so reminders begin right away.
settings.startup.mayNotRead: This session may not read the startup entry, so check the note below.
settings.startup.remove.title: Removing autostart
settings.startup.remove.windows: Turn the switch off. This removes the per-user Run value from {path} and does not require administrator rights.
settings.startup.remove.macos: Turn the switch off. This removes the per-user LaunchAgent {path}.
settings.startup.remove.linux: Turn the switch off, or delete the desktop entry directly:
settings.startup.remove.niri: If you instead added Breathe manually, remove the matching {line} line from {file}.
settings.startup.remove.desktopOnly: Startup integration is only available in the desktop app.
settings.about.title: About
settings.about.description: A calm, minimal desktop companion that reminds you to take short movement breaks and rest your eyes.
settings.about.runtime.title: Runtime
settings.about.runtime.description: Breathe runs a single background scheduler in Rust and only uses the webview for its interface.
settings.about.platform.title: Platform
settings.about.platform.description: Native desktop integration for Linux and Windows. Linux uses XDG conventions; Windows uses the system tray.
settings.about.nonintrusive: Reminders are deliberately nonintrusive: Breathe never locks the screen, grabs focus or opens a blocking window when a break is due.
settings.about.quit.title: Quit Breathe
settings.about.quit.description: Closing the window only hides it. Use this to stop the scheduler and exit.
